info.title: Bandwidth Modification APIs
info.description:
# Introduction
This OpenAPI document combines the Customer Services, Modify Bandwidth, Fetch Status, and Pricing APIs for Telstra connectivity and product solutions.
     

## Features
  Connectivity API  provides below features. 

| Feature |  | Description |
|---|---|---|
|`Retrieve Services` |    | Retrieve, filter, and paginate customer services. |
|`Fetch status` |  | Fetch status of request by unique RequestId. |
|`Modify Bandwidth` |  | Submit bandwidth modification requests for Telstra Internet Direct , Adaptive Fibre and Adaptive Broadband.|
 |`Pricing API` |  | Retirves list prices for the given product.Filter with product and product specific attributes| 
 

## Version Control
This section will be used to keep track of the template version history.

    | Version | Date       | Summary of Change.                                                                

    | 0.4.0   | 2026-04-10 | added AB modify plan API end point and uplift of Get services 

    | 0.3.0   | 2026-03-10 | added Pricing API in the scope                                                                
    | 0.2.0   | 2026-02-28 | Combined release of specification with AF modify BW API included in the scope 

    | 0.1.0   | 2026-01-28 | Combined release of specification with Retrieve Services, TID BW modify, and Fetch Status (generic endpoint)                                                                
    | 0.0.0   | 2025-12-15 | Initial release of the API specification for Retrieve Service, Modify TID BW, and Fetch Status  

## 

---

## Get Services API 
 The Retrieve Services API provides a unified interface for discovering and viewing Telstra connectivity services associated with an account.

 It returns service details, identifiers, status, and product-specific characteristics in a consistent format, enabling customers to inventory, manage, and monitor their services. 

-----

## Modify APIs 
 The Modify Service API allows customers to submit changes to an existing Telstra connectivity service. Supported modifications are validated against product-specific business rules and service constraints before a modification request is created. 

 The API provides a consistent and secure mechanism to manage service changes while maintaining service integrity and compliance with Telstra product policies.

------ 

## Fetch Status API 
 The Fetch Status API enables customers to retrieve the current status of previously submitted modification requests. It provides visibility into the order fulfilment lifecycle by returning status information. This allows customers to monitor request progress and determine when an modification has been successfully completed. 

 The API supports secure access through OAuth2 and follows Telstra's standards for headers, error handling, and documentation.

------- 

## Pricing API
The Pricing API provides a unified interface to retrieve Telstra product pricing information. The prices returned depend on your commercial relationship with Telstra:
- If a Frame Agreement (FA) is in effect, pricing applicable under that agreement will be returned.
- If no Frame Agreement (FA) is in effect, the standard list price will be returned.

**All prices returned by this API exclude GST**

.**Pricing made available through the Price API is confidential and must only be used for your internal business purposes in connection with your Telstra services.**

The API supports filtering by product, charge type, and product-specific attributes, and returns results in a consistent, offset-based paginated format. The API is designed for both broad and fine-grained price discovery, enabling clients to:
- Retrieve list prices for all or specific products
- Filter results using product attributes (e.g., bandwidth, zone, variant)
- Select between recurring and one-off charges
- Page through large result sets using `offset` and `limit` query parameters (client-driven pagination)
- Receive detailed error information in a standard envelope

This API is suitable for integration into quoting tools, product catalogs, and customer-facing applications where up-to-date, accurate pricing is required. Authentication is via OAuth2 client credentials, and all requests and responses follow Telstra's API standards for headers, error handling, and documentation.

### Features
- Retrieve list prices for products
- Filter with `product` and product‑specific `attributes[...]`
- Simple offset-based pagination (using `offset` and `limit` query parameters, as per Telstra API Design Guidelines)
- Consistent error envelope and headers

### Product Filters and Example Values
Below are the supported filters and their example values for each product:

#### adaptive-broadband
- Plan: 50/20 Mbps
- carriageServiceType: TC4
- accessType: nbn
- chargeType: ONE-OFF

#### adaptive-fibre
- bandwidth: 50 Mbps
- zone: Zone 1
- accessType: Adaptive Fibre - NBN
- chargeType: RECURRING

#### TID
- variant: Telstra Internet Direct Lite Adapt
- bandwidth: 50 Mbps
- zone: Zone 1
- chargeType: RECURRING

---

### Getting Access to the API
Access to this API is managed through the Telstra Developer Portal (T.Dev). Only authorised users with the required roles and entitlements can request access and generate credentials.

### Access steps 
1. Log in to T.Dev with your Telstra customer credentials.
2. Request access to the API (approval may be automatic or manual).
3. Once approved, create an application in T.Dev.
4. T.Dev provisions application credentials and enables access to Telstra’s authorization server. These credentials are used to authenticate and call the API. 
5. The API is secured using bearer tokens issued by a Telstra authorization server.

### Getting Started
  1. Obtain your application credentials from T.Dev after access approval.
2. Request an access token from Telstra’s authorization server.
3. Include the access token in the Authorization header for every API request. 
4. Refer to the endpoint documentation below to begin integrating.

### Headers
- **Authorization**: OAuth2ClientCredentials token for authentication (**required**)
- **X-Correlation-Id**: Optional client-supplied correlation ID for tracing; echoed on errors and 500 responses
- **Content-Type**: application/json
- **Accept**: application/json
- **Content-Language**: Returned in all responses
- **Retry-After**: Returned in 429/503 responses

### Notes
- All requests must be authenticated using a valid bearer token or OAuth2 token
- Pagination is supported for large result sets
- Error responses use a Telstra-compliant envelope
- For more details, see the API documentation portal or contact support

---

## Error Code Reference Tables

### Common Error Responses (all APIs)
| HTTP Status | Code                     | Issue                                                                      | Location | Suggested Action                                                                                                      |
|-------------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **401**     | `INVALID_TOKEN`          | The Authentication Token is Missing or Invalid.                            | `header` | Check the Authentication Token. It should be valid, unexpired, and match the one issued by the authentication service.|
| **403**     | `RESOURCE_AUTH_ERR`      | You don't have permission to access this resource.                         | `path`   | Check the permissions/scopes associated with your account and request the correct access if required.                |
| **429**     | `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS`      | The API rate limit has been reached.                                      | `header` | Reduce the number of concurrent calls and retry after the `Retry-After` duration.                                    |
| **500**     | `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`  | An unexpected error occurred.                                             | `server` | Please try again later. If the issue persists, contact Telstra support with your correlationId.                      |
| **503**     | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`    | The server is temporarily unable to handle the request (maintenance/overload).| `server` | Check the `Retry-After` header to see how long you should wait, then try the call again.                             |

> The above common error responses apply to **Customer Services**, **Modify Bandwidth**, **Fetch Status**, and **Pricing** APIs unless otherwise specified in their individual sections.

### Customer Services API
| HTTP Status | Code                   | Issue                                              | Suggested Action                                                                                                   | Location |
|-------------|------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|
| **200**     | `NO_MATCHING_RECORDS`  | No records match the filter criteria.               | Verify filter values or broaden search.                                                                            | `query`  |
| **400**     | `FIELD_INVALID`        | Parameter value is invalid (e.g., type not in allowed list, limit out of range). | Correct the parameter value based on API documentation (e.g., `tid-adapt` or `adaptive-fibre` for `type`).         | `query`  |
| **400**     | `FIELD_MISSING`        | Required parameter is missing.                      | Include all mandatory parameters in the request.                                                                   | `query`  |   |

### Modify Bandwidth API
| HTTP Status | Code                    | Issue                                       | Location  | Suggested Action                                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **400**     | `FIELD_MISSING`       | Required field missing (e.g., `newBandwidth`)                | body      | Include all mandatory fields in the request                                      |
| **400**     | `FIELD_INVALID`       | Invalid value (e.g., unsupported `newBandwidth`)             | body      | Provide a valid value as per documentation                                       |
| **404**     | `NOT_FOUND`           | Service not found or `serviceId`/`cidn` relationship not found| body      | Verify `serviceId` and `cidn`; ensure service is active                         |

### Fetch Status API
| HTTP Status | Code                    | Issue                                       | Location  | Suggested Action                                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **200**     | `CONTRACT_INVALID`    | Contract decision is not permit for this offer     | decision  | Contact account manager to review contract terms/eligibility                     |
| **200**     | `CREDIT_RISK_NO_SELL` | Customer account flagged no-sell                   | decision  | Contact finance/risk team to resolve account status           |
| **200**     | `NEW_BW_GT_AF_SUPPORT`| Requested newBandwidth exceeds supported Adaptive Fibre capacity| decision  | Choose a newBandwidth within Adaptive Fibre supported limit    |
|  **200**     | `NEW_BW_GT_IF_SUPPORT`| Requested newBandwidth exceeds supported Interface Type.|decision | Due to physical change required, proceed to Adaptive Network Centre to raise request .  |
|  **200**     | `NEW_BW_NOT_SUPPORTED`| Underlying access does not support requested newBandwidth.|decision | Choose a Bandwidth within supported Limit or proceed to Adaptive Network Centre to raise request. .                             |
| **400**     | `FIELD_MISSING`       | Required field missing (e.g., requestId)           | body      | Include all mandatory fields in the request                                      |
| **400**     | `FIELD_INVALID`           | Invalid value provided| body      | Correct the value and retry              |
| **403**     | `RESOURCE_AUTH_ERR`       | You don't have permission to access this resource.   | body      | Check the permissions/scopes associated with your account and request the correct access if required.                           |

--------

### Pricing API (`/services/price`)
| HTTP Status | Code                    | Issue                                                                                  | Location | Suggested Action                                                                                             |
|-------------|-------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **200**     | `NO_MATCHING_RECORDS`   | No price records found for the supplied filters.                                      | `query`  | Verify filter values (product/chargeType/attributes) or broaden search (e.g., remove one or more attributes).|
| **400**     | `FIELD_INVALID`         | Invalid filter combination or value (e.g. attributes[] used without product, or bad attribute key/value). | `query`  | Correct the parameter combination/values according to the Pricing API documentation.                         |
| **400**     | `FIELD_MISSING`         | Required parameter missing for this product or pricing request.                       | `query`  | Provide all mandatory parameters such as `product` when required by the selected attributes.                | 

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I obtain API credentials?**  
A: Contact your API administrator or Telstra support to request access. You will receive credentials and instructions for authentication.

**Q: What should I do if I receive a rate limit error (429)?**  
A: Wait for the period specified in the `Retry-After` header before retrying your request.

**Q: How are errors returned by the API?**  
A: All error responses use a Telstra-compliant envelope with detailed error codes, descriptions, and suggested actions. See the error code reference tables above.

**Q: Who do I contact for support or troubleshooting?**  
A: Use the X-Correlation-Id from your response when contacting Telstra support for faster resolution.

**Q: Can I filter and paginate results?**  
A: Yes, use the query parameters as described in the endpoint documentation.

---

For full endpoint, schema, and parameter documentation, see the paths and components sections below.

get.description:
Returns list prices.
Valid combinations: - If `product` is omitted: returns list prices across all products. - If `product` is provided: returns list prices scoped to that product. - `attributes[...]` MUST ONLY be used when `product` is provided.
  If `product` is omitted and `attributes[...]` is supplied, the service returns 400.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: OAuth2 token for authentication.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Unique Correlation Id for each transaction to be used by all consumers.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Accepting with application/json.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Accept type of response (application/json).

parameters.name: Telstra-api-version
parameters.description: B2B2X Header-based API version. Specify the published API minor version (e.g., 1.2).

parameters.name: Accept-Charset
parameters.description: Specifies the character sets that are acceptable for response. Default is UTF-8 if not specified.

parameters.name: Content-Language
parameters.description: Language of the request content (e.g., en, en-US).

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Optional product identifier.

parameters.name: chargeType
parameters.description: Filter by charge type.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description:
Product-specific variation filters. Supported attributes by product: 

 `adaptive-broadband`- plan (e.g. 50/20 Mbps),carriageServiceType (e.g. TC4), accessType (e.g. nbn)

 `Example: attribute[plan]=100/20Mbps&attribute[accessType]=nbn            `

 `adaptive-fibre`-bandwidth (e.g. 50 Mbps),zone (e.g. Zone ),variant (e.g. Adaptive Fibre - NBN).

 `Example: attribute[bandwidth]=50Mbps&attribute[zone]=zone1&attribute[variant]=Adaptive Fibre - NBN`

`tid-adapt`- bandwidth (e.g. 50 Mbps),zone (e.g. Zone) ,variant (e.g. Telstra Internet Direct Lite Adapt)


             Example: attributes[bandwidth]=500Mbps&attributes[zone]=National.
            

These parameter MUST ONLY be used when `product` is provided.  
- If `product` is omitted and `attributes[...]` is supplied, the service returns 400.  
- `Unsupported attributes` for the selected product will return 400 FIELD_INVALID

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first record to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return (max 500).

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation ID echoed back for tracing.
